cypher: MATCH (d:DLDeveloper)-[:DL_AUTHORED_COMMIT]->(c:DLCommit)-[:DL_MODIFIED_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE d.dataset=$dataset AND d.repo=$repo AND d.id=$developer AND f.path ENDS WITH '.md' UNWIND split(f.content,'\n') AS line WITH d,c,f,trim(line) AS heading WHERE heading STARTS WITH '#' WITH f,heading,collect(DISTINCT d.id)+collect(DISTINCT c.id) AS ids RETURN f.path+': '+heading AS entity,f.path+': '+heading AS fact,ids+[f.id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY entity LIMIT 5
